en.title: Mudslide in Yanbian County, Sichuan has caused 2 deaths, 3 missing
en.summary: A mudslide in Sichuan Province's Yanbian County has resulted in two confirmed fatalities as of September 19 at 10 PM, with three additional people still unaccounted for and rescue efforts ongoing.

stories.title: 伊朗称已向美政府传达7项谈判条件

en.title: Iran Says It Has Conveyed 7 Negotiation Conditions to US Government
en.summary: Iran's top national security official stated that Iran has communicated seven conditions necessary for any negotiations to the United States, asserting that accepting these terms is the only way for the US to resolve its difficulties.

stories.title: Analysts tip a stronger hand for China ahead of Xi-Trump summit in Washington

en.title: Analysts tip a stronger hand for China ahead of Xi-Trump summit in Washington
en.summary: Analysts assess that China enters an upcoming summit between Xi and Trump in Washington from a position of strength, supported by recent diplomatic efforts. The meeting aims to advance mutual agreement on constructive strategic stability between the two nations.

en.title: (Taiwan Snapshot) Black Myth: Wukong Concert Sounds in Taipei, "Chosen Ones" Journey West with Music
en.summary: A concert featuring music from the video game Black Myth: Wukong took place in Taipei, Taiwan on September 20.

en.title: 58th ASEAN Economic Ministers Meeting Held in Philippines, Focused on Enhancing Regional Competitiveness
en.summary: The 58th ASEAN Economic Ministers Meeting convened in Pasay City, Philippines on September 19, with discussions centered on trade, investment, digital transformation, and sustainable growth.

en.title: What China really means when it says it's being 'strategic'
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping used the term "strategic" during talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the BRICS summit, emphasizing partnership and mutual opportunity rather than rivalry.

stories.title: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital, after flames seen near Riyadh airport

en.title: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital, after flames seen near Riyadh airport
en.summary: Yemen's Houthi forces claimed responsibility for attacks on Riyadh using missiles and drones on Saturday, following reports of fire and smoke near Saudi Arabia's main airport.

stories.title: Trump says he will create ‘AI Force’, name AI tsar

en.title: Trump says he will create 'AI Force', name AI tsar
en.summary: President Trump announced plans to appoint an artificial intelligence adviser called an AI tsar and establish an AI force, though he provided no implementation details. The announcement comes amid growing concerns among Washington lawmakers about AI technology risks.

stories.title: White House bars CNN, MS Now and Politico reporters after Trump ban

en.title: White House bars CNN, MS Now and Politico reporters after Trump ban
en.summary: The White House revoked press credentials for journalists from CNN, MS Now, and Politico following President Trump's announcement of their ban. The affected outlets indicated they may challenge the ban as inconsistent with First Amendment protections.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s political, business elite pay final respects to Tung Chee-hwa

en.title: Hong Kong's political, business elite pay final respects to Tung Chee-hwa
en.summary: Hong Kong's political and business leaders attended a vigil for Tung Chee-hwa, the city's first chief executive. Beijing sent wreaths for his state funeral while members of the public signed condolence books at community centres.

stories.title: Focused ultrasound could be the next big cancer breakthrough for hard-to-treat tumours

en.title: Focused ultrasound could be the next big cancer breakthrough for hard-to-treat tumours
en.summary: Researchers are testing focused ultrasound technology as a potential treatment for pancreatic cancer and glioblastoma, with experts suggesting significant advances in treating these difficult cancers could emerge within years.

stories.title: Perfect Diary owner Yatsen doubles down on skincare, R&D after business overhaul

en.title: Perfect Diary owner Yatsen doubles down on skincare, R&D after business overhaul
en.summary: Yatsen Group, the Chinese beauty company behind Perfect Diary, plans to focus on expanding skincare products and increasing research and development spending after completing a business restructuring that included acquiring overseas brands.

stories.title: China’s crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?

en.title: China's crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?
en.summary: China is increasing crude oil imports after a period of reduced purchasing during regional tensions, which could affect global oil price stability. However, analysts predict China will not immediately return to pre-conflict import levels due to refinery margin pressures and substantial existing stockpiles.

stories.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources

en.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources
en.summary: Tesla is conducting audits of Chinese suppliers as it prepares to scale up production of its Optimus humanoid robot for global market launch later this year. Multiple Chinese component and parts manufacturers are undergoing these supplier evaluations.
